name: C-RADIOv3 / v4
plain: NVIDIA's C-RADIOv3 (B, L, H, g): one backbone distilled from several teachers (DINOv2, SigLIP 2, SAM), image features at any resolution. NVIDIA Open Model License.
summary: C-RADIOv3 and C-RADIOv4 (NVIDIA 2025 / 2026), the commercially licensed agglomerative ViTs: v3 distilled from CLIP, SigLIP 2, DINOv2 and SAM (ViT-B / L / H / g), v4 from SigLIP 2-g, DINOv3-7B and SAM 3 (ViT-SO400M / H); patch 16, dense patch tokens and a summary embedding (v3: 3 teachers, v4: 2) at any size up to 2048 px.

papers.title: RADIOv2.5: Improved Baselines for Agglomerative Vision Foundation Models
AM-RADIO: Agglomerative Vision Foundation Model -- Reduce All Domains Into One
PHI-S: Distribution Balancing for Label-Free Multi-Teacher Distillation

licence_notes: The weights are governed by the NVIDIA Open Model License Agreement, which allows commercial use (the model card: 'ready for commercial/non-commercial use'). Our code is timm's VisionTransformer plus our own walk; no NVIDIA code is vendored.
limitations: last_hidden_state holds the prefix tokens (v3: 4 summary + 4 registers; v4: 3 summary + 7 registers), then the patches (upstream's `features`).
pooler_output is upstream's `summary`: the summary tokens concatenated (v3: clip, siglip2, dino_v2 = 3 x hidden size; v4: siglip2, dino_v3 = 2 x hidden size).
The teacher adaptors (the heads mapping the summary to CLIP / SigLIP 2 text space) are not included.
v4 is tested by NVIDIA from 256 to 2048 px; our goldens check it at 112 px like v3 (the same code path).

kernels replays a CUDA graph per small input shape without hidden states (up to about 1M activations: ViT-B ~460 px, ViT-L ~300 px), captured on the shape's second call, at most 4 per model; `model.release_graphs()` frees them.

Small kernels calls (graph-sized, with or without `layers`) run GEMMs of at most 600 tokens on cuBLAS: faster in a graph replay (ViT-B/16 224 px: 1.26 against 1.52 ms), about 10 % slower eagerly on ViT-T / B; a replay equals the eager call bit for bit.
`fp32_accumulate = true` puts every GEMM on cuBLAS with fp32 accumulation (the portable precision; slower on GeForce).
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: dense patch features and a pooled image feature.

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.0001 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 5 % and p99 <= 23 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output `last_hidden_state`).
